items.statement: On two wards over six months, the template, prompts and skills session can be delivered to at least 80 percent of eligible patients' teams, and a calibrated quality score can be rated with kappa of at least 0.6.
items.rationale: These are the conditions a later trial depends on; the evidence conflicts on quality, so measurement must be proven first.
items.risks: Rater time; staff turnover on the wards.

items.statement: Mean note quality will rise by at least 1 point on the six-point score when training and monthly feedback accompany the template.
items.rationale: Suggested by the before-after study with training and contradicted by the template-only study.
items.risks: No comparison group in a feasibility study; estimate is imprecise.

items.statement: A telephone option will raise bereaved family response above the 34 percent reported for a postal questionnaire.
items.rationale: Families valued being included, and postal response was low and unequal.
items.risks: Telephone contact soon after a death may distress some families.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 frames progression criteria for a later trial.
